meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会替你跑完插件的语义化版本发布:判断 PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR,同步八个清单文件里的版本号,构建同步、打 tag、建 GitHub release、重生成 CHANGELOG。npm 发布仍由人工执行。
howto.when: 当你要求给 Claude Code 插件升版本、发新版本时接手;先做完全部 agent 负责的环节,最后把 npm publish 交回人工。

say.text: 帮我给这个插件发一个 MINOR 版本
say.note: 会改八个清单文件、打 tag、建 release

say.text: 把版本从 5.2.0 升到 5.3.0 并走完发布流程
say.note: 除 npm publish 外全部自动完成

say.text: 按 PATCH 规则发布,并重生成 CHANGELOG
say.note: 结束时会提醒你运行 npm publish

howto.what_en: Claude runs the plugin's semantic version release: picks PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR, syncs the version across eight manifests, builds-and-syncs, tags, creates the GitHub release, regenerates CHANGELOG. npm publish stays human-run.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to bump or release a Claude Code plugin version; it finishes every agent-side step, then hands npm publish back to the human.

say_en.text: Cut a MINOR release for this plugin
say_en.note: updates eight manifests, tags, creates the release

say_en.text: Bump 5.2.0 to 5.3.0 and run the whole release flow
Do a PATCH release and regenerate the CHANGELOG
say_en.note: ends by telling you to run npm publish
